args.message: Address review: clarify cents parameter and reject negative entries

args.body: Renamed `amt` to `amount_cents` in the helper signature and returned value. Added coverage for the `amount_cents` keyword and positional calls. Local validation: `python -m pytest -q` — 5 passed. Submitted the changes to `entry-helper` (push tool reported success; remote file read-back is currently returning empty results, so I could not independently verify the remote contents).

Added a check that raises `ValueError` when `amount_cents < 0`, while allowing zero and positive amounts. Regression tests cover -1, -125, zero, and a positive amount; `python -m pytest -q` — 5 passed locally. Submitted the changes to `entry-helper` (push tool reported success; remote file read-back is currently returning empty results, so I could not independently verify the remote contents).
